correctness.rationale: Davidson et al. v1 permits the all-active schedule and breaks payoff ties toward defection. For each tentative action, completing the square in the opinion payoff gives the stated optimizer, which is in [0,1]; the action comparison reduces to βλ/(β+λ) times m_i−θ. An anti-phase orbit has H+L=1 by mean preservation over a phase swap and L=p[εH+(1−ε)L], which uniquely solves to the stated H,L. The two inputs are b=ε/(1−p+2pε) and 1−b. Since θ>1/2, the strict requirement 1−b>θ automatically makes b<θ, and is equivalent to ε<ε_*. Equality fails by the tie rule. The positive-priority denominator gives 0<ε_*<1/2. On the two strict branches contracting by p in sup norm follows from row stochasticity and unchanged branch actions; the smaller threshold margin ensures these branches persist under the claimed strict-radius perturbations, including perturbations that are not constant on blocks. The uniform consensus branches are invariant and contract. W² has positive entries, because an intermediate vertex distinct from the endpoints can be chosen, so the four-agent counterexample really is primitive. For the rational witness, b=1/5, 1−b=4/5, the smaller margin is 1/20, and H=9/10, L=1/10. This refutes the unrestricted conjecture under the allowed synchronous schedule but does not contradict Davidson et al.'s proved all-defection theorem or exclude other orbits beyond the cutoff.
residual_risks: The frozen script tests below- and above-threshold profiles and a finite perturbation trajectory. It does not run an equality-cutoff profile in the parameter loop; equality is instead resolved by the analytic strict action threshold. No asynchronous conclusion follows.

For the specified block-constant orbit the full-size statement is mechanically implied: the dynamics on two block values does not depend on block size once p and θ are fixed; lifting preserves the phase, and the earlier row-stochastic contraction works without change in every dimension. Writing the implicit cutoff explicitly and observing uniqueness of the prescribed affine two-step response do not supply a distinct phenomenon or a genuinely new sharp boundary. residual_risks: The comparison is bounded; no assertion of global historical priority is made. The originality failure rests on the checked earlier equivalent reduced dynamics and actual implication, not the absence of other hits or the existence of the later record.

value.rationale: The counterexample and coexistence mechanism are useful, but were already available in the earlier four-player result. For the frozen contribution, repeating vertices without changing the two-state quotient, rearranging its switching inequality, and applying dimension-free row-stochastic contraction do not add a size-dependent effect or a new useful exact boundary. No surviving independent result of scientific value beyond the already useful prior claim is established in this frozen record.
residual_risks: This is a judgment on the incremental contribution of this record, not a denial of the value of the valid counterexample or its basin estimates as mathematical facts.
